To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a dual-polarized, cavity-backed microstrip antenna has been demonstrated that is tunable over a 1:7:1 bandwidth using varactor diode loading.
we have demonstrated a dual-polarized microstrip antenna with a 1.8 GHz tuning range, a 1.0 GHz bandwidth, and differential-mode port-to port isolation of >28dB.
a dual-polarized differential-mode cavity-backed microstrip antenna with independent frequency tuning has been developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication, and testing of a differential dual-polarized microstrip patch antenna.
the design of dual-polarized, cavity-backed microstrip antennas with independent tuning of the two polarizations.
the development of a new type of differential dual-polarized microstrip antenna.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a dual-polarized microstrip patch antenna with independent tuning of two polarizations has been demonstrated for the first time.
a dual-polarized, differential-mode, cavity-backed, microstrip patch antenna with independent frequency tuning has been demonstrated.
the proposed dual-polarized patch antenna is suitable for use as a single-sided radiation element with independent polarization tuning over the entire tuning range.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a dual-polarized, cavity-backed microstrip antenna with independent frequency tuning.
the dual-polarized microstrip patch antenna with independent frequency tuning is suitable for use in wireless communication systems.
we have demonstrated a differential dual-polarized microstrip antenna with independent tuning of the resonant frequency of both polarizations over a 1 GHz range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a dual-polarized, single-sided, differential, tunable antenna can be designed using the transmission-line model and varactors in the proper symmetry planes.
differential-mode operation is an effective approach to achieve independent polarization tuning.
differential feeding is not only useful for achieving high port-to-port isolation, it is also useful for achieving independent frequency tuning of the two polarizations.
